card.name: Any of the components, in allergy warnings
card.fires_on: The word "any" (or a nearby word like "active") in contraindication lines, right after "hypersensitivity to ... or to", where the next words are expected to be components or ingredients of the product.

modes.label: "any" after "or to"
modes.description: The word "any" ending a list of allergens, before "of the components" or "ingredient".
modes.example: is contraindicated in patients with a history of hypersensitivity to ciprofloxacin, to other quinolones, or to<< any>> of the components in this medication.

modes.label: Word before constituents
modes.description: A modifier such as "active" inside the same "any of their ... constituents" phrase.
modes.example: apparent hypersensitivity to any of their<< active>> or extraneous constituents.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward writing "components" or "component" as the next word.
card.plain: It marks the spot in an allergy warning where the text is about to say "any of the components" of the product.
